name: Nimbo
description: A lightweight, end-to-end LLM fine-tuning framework designed for on-device deployment on edge devices and mobile platforms.
features: Complete pipeline: LoRA fine-tune → export/merge → convert to mobile formats → deploy
Minimal dependencies (~50MB) with Triton GPU kernel acceleration (7–8x speedup for RMSNorm)
CoreML export for iOS/macOS with 4/6/8-bit LUT quantization
Supports LLaMA 3.2, EXAONE, Phi, Qwen2, Mistral, Gemma, and more
